newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada spot gas climbs on weather, tight supplies.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot gas climbs on weather, tight supplies.

text.p: Cold weather and tight supplies combined to push Canadian natural gas spot prices up in all regions on Wednesday, traders said.

"Winter time is moving in and NOVA is having a tough time making its line pack," a Calgary-based trader said, refering to NOVA's intra-Alberta pipeline network, the main mover of natural gas in the province.

Gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was talked in the C$1.38 range, up from C$1.30/1.32 last week, as snow fell on the southern part of the province early on Wednesday. November gas was quoted at C$1.36/1.38, down a nickel from Oct 9.
